reveal.description: How text appears: "teletype" (character by character), "glitch" (resolves out of random glyphs) or "none" (instantly). Use an object to override options, e.g. { "type": "teletype", "speed": 20 }. When a screen or the config sets "glitch", consecutive elements that don't set their own reveal glitch in together as one block.
